item.description:
VIDEO | Delhi: Three storey building collapses in Chawri Bazaar area.

AAP leader Kuldeep Kumar says, "A building collapsed here. From 9:00 AM, it is now almost 9:00 PM. In 12 hours, the rescue operation has not been completed. Leave rescue aside, even the debris has not been removed from there. There is still an apprehension, the information I received is that 16 laborers were here. I also spoke to the DM just now; he mentioned that there were 16 people, and some people went back. No one has the exact figure on how many people are inside. Some people's parents and families had come here, and they were sent to LNJP. So our clear demand is that speed should be brought into the rescue operation with immediate effect. If people are trapped inside, their lives should be saved. And immediate action should be taken against the person responsible for this accident."

The 31-year-old has managed 230 runs from eight innings at an average of 32.85, with just one half-century, a 56 against Services.

Those numbers are modest for a batter whose first-class record stands at 8,794 runs from 120 matches at an average of over 46, including 27 centuries and a highest score of 233.

"I don't want to say that I've made many runs this season. I scored about 90 runs (56 and 30 against Services) when the match average was around 140 runs," Abhimanyu pointed out after Bengal's defeat to Maharashtra in their Ranji Trophy match.

This year we had: 30 Gold Medals + 5 World Records + 9 Asian Records + 4 events where Indians swept the entire podium! Two of my favourite data points: Of the 61 athletes making their Asian Para Games debut, 36 came back home with medals. There are 34 medal winners among 56 women athletes! Our athletes have shown that no dream is too big and no challenge too great when there is determination. Those days are long over when society frowned upon youngsters who wanted to pursue sports. Now, if you have the talent, India will support you and cheer for you. Come, play and shine!"

A threat actor on a dark web forum claims to hold records on 7 million customers of Santander Bank Mexico, one of the country's largest banks.

According to the claim:
* About 7 million customer records
* Said to come from Santander's Mexican operations
* No verifiable sample shown in the post

The claim has not been independently verified, and Santander Mexico has not commented.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
A listing with the same "7 million" figure and a Santander Mexico label appeared on another forum in early October under a different alias, so this may be recirculated or aggregated data rather than a fresh breach. Even so, bank-branded datasets fuel phishing and fake bank-call fraud. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

Come, play and shine!

🇺🇸 🚨 SMITH DOUGLAS HOMES: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS 166K-ROW CUSTOMER AND SALES LEAD DATABASE

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be offering data from Smith Douglas Homes, a publicly traded US homebuilder based in Woodstock, Georgia.

The listing claims 166,571 contact rows plus a sales leads table, allegedly including:
* Full names, emails and phone numbers
* Street addresses, cities, states and postal codes
* Lifecycle stage, community and division interest
* Sales call attempts and web activity data

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
This looks like CRM data on homebuyer prospects. Home buyers are prime targets for real estate wire fraud, so expect fake closing, deposit or builder emails aimed at people on these lists. The company has not confirmed an incident. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

item.title: RT PIB India: Team led by Indian astronomers redefine star cluster UBC 63 as a double cluster system spotted after close flyby 🌟UBC 63, a poorly po...
item.description:
RT PIB India
Team led by Indian astronomers redefine star cluster UBC 63 as a double cluster system spotted after close flyby

🌟UBC 63, a poorly populated group of stars, bound loosely by gravity (Galactic open cluster) about 4892 light years away from the Earth, which was previously identified as a single star cluster, has now been found to be composed of two distinct star clusters.

🌟The chance discovery provided a rare opportunity to study the aftermath of a close flyby between two stellar systems and offers new insights into the dynamical evolution of star clusters in the Milky Way.

🌟Star clusters are important building blocks of galaxies. They are groups of stars that form within the same large reservoirs of gas and dust and subsequently evolve under the influence of their own gravity as well as the broader Galactic environment. Among them, historically, UBC 63 has remained largely overlooked, with limited literature providing only preliminary parameter estimates that presumed it to be a single cluster.

🌟A team led by Astronomers from India, including a Department of Science and Technology (DST) INSPIRE Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and researchers of the Gauhati University, and researchers of the Indian Institute of Astrophysics (IIA), a DST autonomous institution, who set out to investigate star formation dynamics within the UBC 63 cluster using data from the European Space Agency's (ESA) Gaia mission discovered to their surprise that UBC 63 actually consists of two clusters, UBC 63A and UBC 63B, that recently passed remarkably close to each other.

➡️For more details, read here: https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2333191
